correlation_note: This award's start date (2025-10-01) falls after event-simon-took-office (2025-01-03), roughly 9 months later. This proximity is NOT evidence of any relationship: HUD Continuum of Care awards are made annually through a competitive Notice of Funding Opportunity scored by HUD staff against published criteria, not by individual House members, and Insight Housing has received CoC-pattern HUD awards in this recurring annual cycle independent of who holds the CA-12 seat (see baseline context below). Flagged per issue #8's requirement to surface temporal proximity explicitly and mark it correlation_only rather than silently noting or silently ignoring it.
